title: Verbs with two objects - Direct and indirect objects

options.answer: She gave me the book.
She gave to me the book.
She gave the book me.

explanation.en: With verbs like 'give', the indirect object comes before the direct object when no preposition is used.
explanation.ru: С глаголами типа 'give' косвенное дополнение стоит перед прямым дополнением, когда предлог не используется.
explanation.uz: 'Give' kabi fe'llar bilan bilvosita to'ldiruvchi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchidan oldin keladi, agar predlog ishlatilmasa.

options.answer: I bought for my sister a gift.
I bought my sister a gift.
I bought to my sister a gift.

explanation.en: The verb 'buy' takes an indirect object without a preposition, followed by the direct object.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'buy' принимает косвенное дополнение без предлога, за которым следует прямое дополнение.
explanation.uz: 'Buy' fe'li prelogsiz bilvosita to'ldiruvchi oladi, keyin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchi keladi.

options.answer: He told the story to his children.
He told to his children the story.
He told his children to the story.

explanation.en: When using 'to' with the indirect object, it must come after the direct object.
explanation.ru: При использовании 'to' с косвенным дополнением, оно должно стоять после прямого дополнения.
explanation.uz: Bilvosita to'ldiruvchi bilan 'to' ishlatilganda, u to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchidan keyin kelishi kerak.

options.answer: She made a cake for her mother.
She made her mother a cake.
She made to her mother a cake.

explanation.en: The verb 'make' requires the preposition 'for' when the indirect object follows the direct object.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'make' требует предлог 'for', когда косвенное дополнение следует за прямым дополнением.
explanation.uz: 'Make' fe'li bilvosita to'ldiruvchi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchidan keyin kelganda 'for' predlogini talab qiladi.

options.answer: They sent him a letter.
They sent a letter to him.
They sent to him a letter.

explanation.en: Both patterns are correct with 'send': indirect object first without preposition, or direct object first with 'to'.
explanation.ru: С глаголом 'send' правильны обе конструкции: косвенное дополнение первым без предлога, или прямое дополнение первым с 'to'.
explanation.uz: 'Send' bilan ikkala shakl ham to'g'ri: prelogsiz bilvosita to'ldiruvchi birinchi, yoki 'to' bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchi birinchi.

options.answer: I lent him my car.
I lent to him my car.
I lent my car him.

explanation.en: The verb 'lend' takes an indirect object without a preposition, followed by the direct object.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'lend' принимает косвенное дополнение без предлога, за которым следует прямое дополнение.
explanation.uz: 'Lend' fe'li prelogsiz bilvosita to'ldiruvchi oladi, keyin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchi keladi.

options.answer: He showed the photos to his friends.
He showed to his friends the photos.
He showed his friends to the photos.

explanation.en: With 'show', when using 'to', the direct object comes first, then 'to' + indirect object.
explanation.ru: С глаголом 'show' при использовании 'to' прямое дополнение стоит первым, затем 'to' + косвенное дополнение.
explanation.uz: 'Show' bilan 'to' ishlatilganda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchi birinchi, keyin 'to' + bilvosita to'ldiruvchi keladi.

options.answer: She teaches English to children.
She teaches children English.
She teaches to children English.

explanation.en: The verb 'teach' commonly uses the pattern: indirect object + direct object without preposition.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'teach' обычно использует структуру: косвенное дополнение + прямое дополнение без предлога.
explanation.uz: 'Teach' fe'li odatda quyidagi tuzilishni ishlatadi: prelogsiz bilvosita to'ldiruvchi + to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchi.

options.answer: I wrote a letter to my friend.
I wrote to my friend a letter.
I wrote my friend to a letter.

explanation.en: With 'write', the preposition 'to' is used after the direct object when specifying the recipient.
explanation.ru: С глаголом 'write' предлог 'to' используется после прямого дополнения при указании получателя.
explanation.uz: 'Write' bilan qabul qiluvchini ko'rsatishda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchidan keyin 'to' predlogi ishlatiladi.

options.answer: They offered the job to him.
They offered to him the job.
They offered him to the job.

explanation.en: The verb 'offer' uses the pattern: direct object + 'to' + indirect object.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'offer' использует структуру: прямое дополнение + 'to' + косвенное дополнение.
explanation.uz: 'Offer' fe'li quyidagi tuzilishni ishlatadi: to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchi + 'to' + bilvosita to'ldiruvchi.
